description: Check an AI agent before you deal with it. Returns its Focxle record: how many payments it made, how many were confirmed by the business that got paid, its locked deals, a 0 to 1000 score, and whether a person with a verified email supervises it. A score built only from the agent's own word stops at 450 and says so. Free, no account needed. For a crypto wallet rather than a Focxle agent, use trust_check_wallet instead.

limit.description: How many recent payments to return. Default 25.

name: trust_check_agent
